items.title: A model of errors in transformers
items.summary: The authors argue that incorrect deterministic outputs arise when small attention errors accumulate past a threshold, and derive a two-parameter relationship between task accuracy and complexity, interpreted as an elementary noise rate and a count of plausible erroneous tokens. Tests with Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and DeepSeek R1 show good agreement across tasks with some deviations, and the paper shows how prompt construction can reduce error rates.

items.title: Legal Retrieval for Public Defenders
items.title_zh: 面向公共辩护人的法律检索
items.summary: In partnership with the New Jersey Office of the Public Defender, the authors build NJ BriefBank, a retrieval tool that surfaces relevant appellate briefs, and find that existing retrieval benchmarks do not transfer to public-defense research. Adding legal query expansion, domain-specific data, and curated synthetic examples improves retrieval, and they release a query taxonomy and a manually annotated evaluation dataset.

items.title: ReSearch: A Multi-Stage Machine Learning Framework for Earth Science Data Discovery
items.title_zh: ReSearch：面向地球科学数据发现的多阶段机器学习框架
items.summary: ReSearch frames Earth Science data discovery as an iterative process of intent interpretation, high-recall retrieval, and context-aware ranking, combining lexical search, semantic embeddings, abbreviation expansion, and LLM reranking. On a literature-grounded benchmark it improves recall and ranking over baselines, especially for task-based queries that express abstract scientific goals.

items.title: Evaluating Few-Shot Temporal Reasoning of LLMs for Human Activity Prediction in Smart Environments
items.title_zh: 评估大语言模型在智能环境中预测人类活动的少样本时间推理能力
items.summary: The paper uses retrieval-augmented prompting that combines temporal, spatial, behavioral-history, and persona context to test whether LLMs can predict human activities and durations in a smart home. On the CASAS Aruba dataset, zero-shot models already produce coherent daily activity predictions, one or two demonstrations refine duration calibration and accuracy, and performance saturates beyond a few examples.

items.title: XR: Cross-Modal Agents for Composed Image Retrieval
items.title_zh: XR：面向组合图像检索的跨模态智能体
items.summary: XR is a training-free multi-agent framework for composed image retrieval that coordinates imagination agents, similarity agents, and question agents to progressively refine results against semantic and visual constraints. It reports gains of up to 38% over strong training-free and training-based baselines on FashionIQ, CIRR, and CIRCO, with ablations indicating each agent is necessary.

items.title: Zero-shot adaptable task planning for autonomous construction robots: a comparative study of lightweight single and multi-AI agent systems
items.title_zh: 自主建筑机器人的零样本可适应任务规划：轻量单智能体与多智能体系统对比研究
items.summary: The study compares one single-agent and three multi-agent task-planning systems built from lightweight open-source LLMs and VLMs across painter, safety-inspector, and floor-tiling roles. The four-agent team outperformed GPT-4o on most metrics while being ten times more cost-effective, and three- and four-agent teams showed better generalizability.

items.title: Large Language Model-Powered Evolutionary Code Optimization on a Phylogenetic Tree
items.title_zh: 基于系统发育树的大语言模型进化式代码优化
items.summary: PhyloEvolve is an LLM-agent system that treats GPU-oriented code optimization as in-context reinforcement learning and uses a phylogenetic tree to track inheritance, divergence, and recombination among code variants.

items.title: WordPress/agent-skills
items.title_zh: WordPress/agent-skills：面向 AI 编程助手的 WordPress 技能
items.summary: WordPress/agent-skills is a JavaScript repository that packages WordPress knowledge for AI coding assistants, covering blocks, themes, plugins, and best practices.
